title: Short Egyptian fractions

result.label: Short Egyptian fractions
result.statement: Every rational a/b with 1 a b is a sum of O( b) distinct positive unit fractions. The worst-case minimum number of terms has the same order, resolving Erdős’s conjecture on short Egyptian fractions.
